package.description: Control Apple Studio Display and Pro Display XDR brightness from Windows.

en-US.description: Control Apple Studio Display and Pro Display XDR brightness from Windows.
en-US.longDescription: NitTray is a free, open-source Windows system-tray app that adjusts the brightness of the Apple Studio Display and Pro Display XDR over USB — no Mac required. It lists each connected Apple display with its own brightness slider and runs on Windows 10 and 11 (x64 and Arm64).
en-US.name: NitTray
